system.title: Parameter estimation of a whole-brain model with a hybrid physics-informed neural network (r12)

planets.label: Hybrid PINN estimation of MPR whole-brain parameters
planets.detail: Estimate the global coupling G and a map-based description of the regional excitabilities of an MPR whole-brain model with a hybrid physics-informed neural network.

evidence.quote: a low-dimensional description of the regional excitabilities $\eta_i$ of a Montbrió–Pazó–Roxin (MPR) whole-brain model, estimated with a hybrid physics-informed neural network (PINN)

planets.label: Resting-state functional connectivity
planets.detail: The simulated BOLD, through a Balloon-Windkessel model, must reproduce the measured resting-state FC of one subject.

evidence.quote: reproduce the resting-state BOLD of a real subject

planets.label: Physics-informed neural networks
planets.detail: A network maps time to (r, V) of every region; the residuals of the MPR equations enter the loss.

evidence.quote: no PINN has been applied to the whole-brain MPR model with real BOLD

planets.label: Single-subject resting-state fMRI
planets.detail: Any instance with N regions, T volumes at TR, field B0 and echo time TE; version 1 uses one subject of 1000BRAINS v1.1.

evidence.quote: one subject of a resting-state dataset, parcellated into $N$ regions, with $T$ volumes at repetition time TR

planets.label: Static FC does not determine one excitability per region
planets.detail: Distinct regional parameter sets reproduce the same FC, so free regional excitabilities are not identifiable.

evidence.quote: Static FC does not determine one excitability per region

planets.label: Map-based excitabilities and hidden states from a hybrid PINN on real BOLD
planets.detail: The PINN estimates G and a myelin-map description of the excitabilities, benchmarked against sweep and CMA-ES, and reconstructs the hidden neural trajectories, tested on synthetic data.

evidence.quote: What a PINN adds over these estimators is that it reconstructs the hidden neural trajectories together with the parameters

planets.label: Parameter inference for brain network models
planets.detail: Estimation of the parameters of a connectome-based model from neuroimaging data.

evidence.quote: Only $\eta_0$, $a$ and $G$ are estimated; every other parameter is fixed and declared.

planets.label: Hybrid PINN benchmarked against sweep and CMA-ES
planets.detail: Differentiable RK4 Balloon-Windkessel forward model trained jointly with the parameters; FC fit compared with a parameter sweep and CMA-ES on the same parameters.

evidence.quote: no lower than that of a parameter sweep and of CMA-ES fitting the same three parameters

planets.label: Low-dimensional regional parametrisation
planets.detail: eta_i = eta_0 + a m_i with the group T1w/T2w myelin map, three parameters instead of N+1; free eta_i kept as a control.

evidence.quote: the regional excitabilities are tied to a fixed map with two free parameters

planets.label: Identifiability before interpretation
planets.detail: Synthetic recovery is required before real-data convergence across seeds and sessions is interpreted.

evidence.quote: H2 is required: convergence on real data (H3) is interpreted only after H2 holds

planets.label: Physics residual scales for hidden states
planets.detail: Equations non-dimensionalised; each residual divided by a fixed scale derived from the magnitude of the terms of its equation.

evidence.quote: each residual is divided by the sum of the absolute values of the terms of its equation

planets.label: Dynamical regime tested, not assumed
planets.detail: Fits in the bistable and in the monostable range of eta are compared; bistability is a result, not a condition.

evidence.quote: Whether $\eta_0$ lies in the bistable range is a result (H4), not a condition.

planets.label: FC fit read against ceilings and benchmarks
planets.detail: Expected, not yet measured: rho_FC against the seed ceiling, the session ceiling when available, and the sweep and CMA-ES fits.

evidence.quote: Success is read against the ceilings of Section 6

planets.label: Parameters interpreted only if identifiable
planets.detail: Expected, not yet measured: parameters are interpreted only after synthetic recovery and convergence across seeds and sessions.

evidence.quote: The parameters are called interpretable when three conditions hold.

pillars.label: Hybrid PINN with benchmark
pillars.detail: A PINN with a differentiable RK4 Balloon-Windkessel forward model, trained jointly with the parameters and compared with a parameter sweep and CMA-ES on the same parameters.

pillars.label: Low-dimensional regional parametrisation
pillars.detail: eta_i = eta_0 + a m_i with a fixed regional map m_i, so that three parameters (eta_0, a, G) replace N+1.

pillars.label: Identifiability before interpretation
pillars.detail: Synthetic recovery first, then convergence across seeds and initial values on real data, then agreement across sessions when available.

pillars.label: Dynamical regime tested, not assumed
pillars.detail: Fits restricted to the bistable and to the monostable range of eta are compared rather than bistability being imposed.

hypotheses.statement: The PINN finds eta_0, a and G whose forward MPR, Balloon-Windkessel and BOLD simulation yields an FC with rho_FC no lower than a parameter sweep and CMA-ES fitting the same three parameters, read against the seed ceiling.
From BOLD generated with known eta_0, a and G away from the prior centre, the method recovers them within a declared tolerance and recovers the hidden trajectories r_i, V_i of the generator.

Repeated training with different seeds and initial values converges to the same eta_0, a and G, and to the same values across sessions when the subject has two; with eta_i free in every region, as a control, it does not.
Fits restricted to the bistable range of eta and fits restricted to the monostable range differ in rho_FC by more than the seed variability; either sign is reported.
